title: atalantia citrifolia
intro: Atalantia citrifolia, commonly known as the Atalantia or citrus pepper, is a species of plant in the family Rutaceae, characterized by its small, yellowish-green flowers and edible fruit. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal and culinary properties. The health benefits of Atalantia citrifolia include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in the treatment of various diseases such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve nausea and vomiting, and exhibit anti-cancer properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as limonoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids.
